profile_interventions: Inline recorded baseline Dockerfile instead of ephemeral parent tag
Restore baseline compiled extensions before learner start
scope: Numerical software repair of the reported ANCOM-BC2 responsibility-underflow regression, with native product reward and retained regression suite. Not evidence of general scientific equivalence to R.
biological_reasoning: limited; issue supplies reproducer, expected values and a proposed fix
inputs: Upstream numerical regression fixture; not established observed biological measurements. Sampling provenance is limited to the upstream issue report.

reward.formula: F2P pass fraction multiplied by P2P pass fraction, rounded to six decimals
reward.strict_resolution: all F2P and P2P passing; recorded separately

gates.instruction_verifier_agreement: The private regression uses the exact four-by-three reproducer, grouping contrast, expected LFCs and p-values stated in the issue; regression protection covers existing library behavior. E-step-only success does not contradict the instruction, which does not require the extra M-step edit.
gates.tolerances: Upstream numpy.testing.assert_allclose uses explicit atol=1e-6 and its native default relative tolerance. This preserves the native regression contract; the R implementation was not independently rerun.
gates.full_partial_incorrect: Reference 1, alternative 1, baseline 0, wrong uniform responsibilities 0, grouping regression 0.983051, with all 60 outcomes parsed in native and converted runs.
gates.repeatability: The original five native rewards repeated on fresh workers; the six portable-profile rewards match native and converted paths. Limited deterministic replay, not exhaustive platform stability.
gates.isolation: Private oracle/verifier paths absent before all 12 learner executions; converted grading uses separate sandbox and leaves private paths absent afterward. Dockerfile fetches the pinned baseline, removes remotes/other refs and expires reflogs; private solution and test-patch assets are staged separately.
gates.environment: Portable context builds; initial imports pass in all 12 executions. Exact tested dependency versions recorded in controls; base-image tag and package-index resolution remain rebuild dependencies.
gates.conversion: Pinned Marin 45a044387ccd95ab698b4a592056aadaff961540 schema and native/converted six-case reward/count parity verified.

limitations: Acceptance is for the explicit adapted pilot profile, not the original ephemeral-tag task.
One F2P fixture and 59 P2P tests do not establish exhaustive numerical generalization.
Prompt contains expected values and a suggested fix, limiting difficulty.
Deferred report-integrity diagnostic remains unexecuted; these results do not claim adversarial grader hardening.
Public image publication, Atlas admission and training readiness remain separate.
